title: GOSHEN COACH: FMVSS 108/REFLEX REFLECTORS (1,333 affected)
summary: CERTAIN BUSES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."  THE BUSES WERE BUILT WITHOUT THE REQUIRED REFLEX REFLECTORS ON THE REAR AND REAR SIDE AND, ON CERTAIN MODELS, THE SIDE INTERMEDIATE REFLECTORS ARE  MISSING.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: FRONT BRAKE SYSTEM (510 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, DURING LONG PERIODS OF RIDING AT SUSTAINED HIGH ENGINE RPM, VIBRATION WITHIN THE BRAKE FLUID RESERVOIR CAN CAUSE THE BRAKE FLUID TO FOAM.  THIS COULD ALLOW AIR TO ENTER THE FRONT BRAKE SYSTEM WHICH COULD LEAD TO A LOSS OF FRONT BRAKING EFFICIENCY.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: ENGINE FAILURE/ISL CM850 ENGINES/CUMMINS (2 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN EMERGENCY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH CUMMINS ISL CM850 DIESEL ENGINES,  THE CONNECTING RODS WHICH TRANSFER ENERGY FROM THE PISTON TO THE CRANKSHAFT ARE DEFECTIVE AND CAN RESULT IN SEIZURE OF THE PISTON PIN.  A PISTON PIN SEIZURE CAN RESULT IN A MISSION-DISABLING ENGINE FAILURE.

title: FTCA, Inc.: POWER LIFT ROOF SYSTEM (2,129 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN RECREATIONAL VEHICLES, THE POWER LIFT ROOF SYSTEM, WHICH CONSISTS OF A POWER LIFT MOTOR AND CURRENT LIMITER CONTROLLER, GENERATES EXCESSIVE AMOUNTS OF IMPACT TORQUE IF THE POWER LIFT IS OPERATED WITH THE 30A POWER CORD PLUGGED INTO A 110V AC POWER SOURCE (WITH OR WITHOUT A BATTERY).

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: FMVSS 208/REAR OUTBOARD SEAT BELTS (5,823 affected)
summary: CERTAIN VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH SOME OF THE  REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."  THE REAR OUTBOARD SEAT BELTS DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE LAP-BELT LOCKABILITY REQUIREMENT WHICH ENABLES THE LAP BELT PORTION OF THE BELT TO BE LOCKED BY THE USER TO FACILITATE THE USE OF OLDER NON-LATCH DESIGN CHILD RESTRAINT DEVICES.

title: General Motors, LLC: FMVSS 118/SUNROOF (16,677 affected)
summary: CERTAIN VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 118, 'POWER OPERATED WINDOW, PARTITION, AND ROOF PANEL SYSTEMS.'  UNDER THE STANDARD, THE SUNROOF MAY ONLY BE CLOSED WHEN THE IGNITION IS ON, OR AFTER THE IGNITION IS TURNED OFF, BUT BEFORE EITHER OF THE FRONT DOORS ARE OPENED.  THE AFFECTED VEHICLES MAY EXHIBIT A CONDITION WHERE THE SUNROOF CAN BE CLOSED AFTER THE IGNITION IS TURNED OFF AND THE DOORS ARE OPENED.

title: General Motors, LLC: STEERING GEAR ASSEMBLY/ZF (990 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MEDIUM DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH ZF MODEL 8018 STEERING GEARS, THE STEERING GEAR MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED INCORRECTLY.  A STEERING GEAR WITH THIS CONDITION MAY PRODUCE THE FEELING OF HITTING A CURB AND A CRACKING OR PINGING SOUND WHEN THE STEERING WHEEL IS TURNED.

title: Pierce Manufacturing: PITMAN ARM (2,604 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN FIRE TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH AN INDEPENDENT FRONT SUSPENSION, A PITMAN ARM MIGHT FRACTURE UNDER SEVERE LOAD CAUSED BY THREE LOADING CONDITIONS.   IN ALL CASES, THE FRONT AXLE MUST BE TURNED FULL LEFT OR RIGHT WHILE (1)  SIMULTANEOUSLY  BACKING UP AND BRAKING HARD, (2) DRIVING ONE WHEEL OVER OR AGAINST A CURB OR (3) STEERING THE FRONT AXLE FULL LEFT OR RIGHT WHEN THE VEHICLE IS STATIONARY WITH THE SERVICE BRAKE APPLIED.  THESE ARE ALL LOW OR NO -SPEED EVENTS.

title: WU'S INTERNATIONAL TRADE: FMVSS 108/HID CONVERSION KITS (313 affected)
summary: CERTAIN AFTERMARKET PILOT HID CONVERSION KITS CONTAINING HID BALLASTS AND HID BULBS FAIL TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL TANK STRAPS (548 affected)

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): LEFT RADIATOR COOLING FAN MOTOR CONNECTOR (102,042 affected)

title: Ducati North America: BATTERY FASTENING (385 affected)

title: PROGRESSIVE INDUSTRIES: REFRIGERATOR/DOMETIC (10 affected)

title: Payless ShoeSource Recalls Girls' Boots Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The guitar-shaped zipper pulls on each boot can interlock while a child is walking, causing the child to trip and fall. Units: About 90,000.

title: The Gymboree Corp. Recalls Toy Swords Due to Breakage and Laceration Hazard
summary: The swords can break, creating a sharp point, which poses a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: Albert's Recalls Halloween Skull Pails Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paint on the eyes, nose, and teeth of the skull contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 55,000.

title: Antioch Publishing Recalls Additional Bookmarks Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Paint on the clip of the bookmarks contains excessive levels of lead, which violates the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 200,000 (an additional 150,000 bookmarks and journals were recalled on October 4, 2007).

title: Deere & Company Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The brake calipers in the front of the utility vehicles may have been installed incorrectly, causing the vehicle to pull to one side during braking. This poses an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,400.

title: Dunkin' Donuts Recalls Glow Sticks Due to Choking and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The recalled glow sticks are not properly labeled to warn consumers that the cap and lanyard can detach, posing a choking hazard. Additionally, the lanyard poses a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 1 million.

title: Guidecraft Inc. Recalls Children's Puppet Theaters Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the puppet theater's wooden panels contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 5,400.

title: Plow & Hearth Recalls Aluminum Chimeneas Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: A design flaw can cause the aluminum on the chimeneas to catch fire or melt under high temperatures, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 247.

title: Formula Brake USA Recalls Disc Brakes for Bicycles Due to Risk of Failure
summary: The brake's hand lever can separate, resulting in loss of braking. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle, posing a risk of injury to riders. Units: About 5,700.

title: Huffy Recalls Bicycles Due To Cranks Falling Off; Riders Can Lose Control of Bike
summary: The bicycle crank can unexpectedly come off, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 22,000.

title: Procycle Group Inc. Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The head tube can detach from the rest of the frame, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 45.

title: Yamaha Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Risk of Injury and Death from Steering Problem
summary: Snow and ice stuck around the steering idler arm can cause a loss of steering ability, posing a risk of injury and death to drivers and passengers. Units: About 5,700.

title: Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Crash and Fire Hazards
summary: The snowmobiles' fuel tanks can crack allowing liquid fuel and fuel vapor to leak, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. In addition, a problem with the throttle cable can lead to loss of speed control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 2,700.

title: Halloween "Ugly Teeth" Recalled By Amscan Inc. Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paint on the teeth contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 43,000.

title: SimplyFun Recalls Ribbit Board Games Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: Surface paint on the five frog-shaped wooden pieces contain excess levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 1,500.

title: Toy Figures Recalled by Henry Gordy International Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the recalled toys contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 380,000.

title: Toys "R" Us Recalls Elite Operations Toys Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface coatings on the toys contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 16,000.

title: Connecticut Electric Recalls Counterfeit Square D Circuit Breakers Due To Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled circuit breakers labeled "Square D" are counterfeit and could fail to trip when they are required to, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 64,000.

title: Digital Color Printers Recalled by Oki Data Americas Due to Risk of Electrical Shock
summary: The recalled digital color printers have an internal electrical problem that could result in electrical shock to consumers. Units: About 400.

title: Target Recalls Home Patio Sets Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair can collapse when weight is applied to the front end of the arm rests, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 40,000.
